summary_1line: Satyaki condemns the injustice done to the Pandavas and urges Krishna and Balarama to launch an immediate war against the Kauravas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki, blazing with anger in an assembly before Krishna and Balarama, raises his hand and calls for the Vrishni army to march against the Kauravas.
He describes Bhima in the forest—emaciated, clad in bark garments, yet gripping weapons in fury while remembering his suffering.
Satyaki imagines the battlefield where he severs Duryodhana’s head with a flashing sword amid chariots and flying arrows.
